integrity: A complete mathematical proof is supplied, with two replayable independent exact finite checks. The source gap formula is attributed, and external independent audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous simple random walk on a labeled simple cycle; f failed sources retain their vertices and incident edges but lose pinned status. No claim for damaged graphs, directed walks, heterogeneous fidelity, or uniform polynomial complexity of enumerating all optimum sets.
title: Sharp fault-tolerant discounted hitting domination on cycles
